name: Korean peninsula
summary: No North Korean missile launch found since multiple missiles were fired on 4 Nov
state: North Korea fired multiple missiles on 4 Nov, its fourth weapons launch in a month, according to Seoul (The Star/Reuters), and said it had tested a new air-defence system and a long-range cruise missile (Stars and Stripes, 5 Nov). Searches to 23 Nov found no later launch confirmed by South Korea's military, and no nuclear test or border clash, so with no launch in the past two weeks the level stays Normal.
for_you: No change for travel to South Korea or Japan. North Korean launches rarely affect daily life; follow FCDO travel advice and local alerts if a launch warning is issued.
rubric_hit: Normal: no missile launches in two weeks (last launch 4 Nov); no border incidents
